description: Stores from our weekly census of 65,000 top sites, filtered by what a shopping agent needs: ships to a country, UCP agent checkout and its capabilities, payment handlers (Google Pay, Shop Pay), currency, return window. Facts from each store's own machine-readable files, never its policy pages. Most visited first. Signed. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana).
